result.instructions: Tools for Invoice Ninja, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Invoice Ninja data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run invoiceninja_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run invoiceninja_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run invoiceninja_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. invoiceninja_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients with balances and contacts, optionally searched by name, email or number. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/clients.

filter.description: Free-text search across name, id number, contact names/emails/phones and custom fields.

email.description: Only the client with a contact at this email.

number.description: Only the client with this client number.

balance.description: Balance comparison "op:value", op one of lt, lte, gt, gte, eq, e.g. "gt:0".

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

tools.name: invoiceninja_get_client
tools.title: Get one client
tools.description: Fetch one client by id, with contacts, address, balance and paid-to-date. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/clients/{id}.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, filterable by client and payment status (paid / unpaid / overdue). status_id on each invoice: 1 draft, 2 sent, 3 partial, 4 paid, 5 cancelled, 6 reversed. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/invoices.

client_id.description: Only records for this client (hashed id).

client_status.description: Comma-separated payment status: all, paid, unpaid, overdue.

number.description: Only the invoice with this number.

filter.description: Free-text search across number, PO number, date, amount, balance, client name/contacts and line items.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

tools.name: invoiceninja_get_invoice
tools.title: Get one invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice by id — line items, totals, balance, dates, status and invitations. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: List quotes (estimates), filterable by client and quote status. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/quotes.

client_id.description: Only records for this client (hashed id).

client_status.description: Comma-separated quote status: all, draft, sent, approved, expired, upcoming.

number.description: Only the quote with this number.

filter.description: Free-text search across number and custom fields.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

tools.name: invoiceninja_get_quote
tools.title: Get one quote
tools.description: Fetch one quote by id — line items, totals, status and the invoice it was converted to (invoice_id), if any. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/quotes/{id}.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products / services in the catalog with price, cost and default taxes. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/products.

product_key.description: Only the product with this product key.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments received, with amount, date, refunded/applied totals and the invoices each was applied to (paymentables). Read-only: this server never records or refunds payments. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/payments.

client_id.description: Only records for this client (hashed id).

number.description: Only the payment with this number.

filter.description: Free-text search across amount, date and custom fields.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List expenses, filterable by client and invoicing/payment state. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/expenses.

client_id.description: Only records for this client (hashed id).

client_status.description: Comma-separated: all, logged, pending, invoiced, uninvoiced, paid, unpaid.

number.description: Only the expense with this number.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors
tools.description: List vendors (suppliers) with contacts and address. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/vendors.

filter.description: Free-text search across vendor name and contacts.

number.description: Only the vendor with this number.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks / time entries with their time_log, duration, rate and linked client, project and invoice. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/tasks.

client_id.description: Only records for this client (hashed id).

client_status.description: Comma-separated: all, invoiced, uninvoiced, is_running, overdue.

number.description: Only the task with this number.

filter.description: Free-text search across task description and custom fields.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects with client, budgeted hours, task rate, current hours and due date. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/projects.

client_id.description: Only records for this client (hashed id).

filter.description: Free-text search across project name and notes.

number.description: Only the project with this number.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_recurring_invoices
tools.title: List recurring invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoice schedules with frequency, next send date and remaining cycles. Read-only. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/recurring_invoices.

client_id.description: Only records for this client (hashed id).

number.description: Only the recurring invoice with this number.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client, optionally with contacts. Give at least a name or one contact. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/clients.

country_id.description: Country as its ISO 3166-1 NUMERIC code, as a string, e.g. "840" (US), "826" (UK), "276" (DE).

id_number.description: Your own id / registration number for this client.

contacts.description: People at the client; the first is the primary contact.

send_email.description: Whether this contact receives invoice emails.

tools.name: invoiceninja_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Update a client's details; only the fields you pass change. Passing contacts replaces the contact list. Invoice Ninja: PUT /api/v1/clients/{id}.

country_id.description: Country as its ISO 3166-1 NUMERIC code, as a string, e.g. "840" (US), "826" (UK), "276" (DE).

id_number.description: Your own id / registration number for this client.

send_email.description: Whether this contact receives invoice emails.

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT invoice for a client. It is not sent or emailed — use invoiceninja_mark_invoice_sent or invoiceninja_email_invoice afterwards. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/invoices.

number.description: Document number. Omit to let Invoice Ninja assign the next one.

line_items.description: Line items. On update this REPLACES all existing lines.

discount.description: Line discount (amount or percent, see is_amount_discount).

is_amount_discount.description: true = discount is an amount; false = a percentage.

private_notes.description: Internal notes, not shown to the client.

is_amount_discount.description: true = discount is an amount; false = a percentage.

partial_due_date.description: Due date of the partial amount, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: invoiceninja_update_invoice
tools.title: Update an invoice
tools.description: Edit an invoice; only the fields you pass change, but line_items (if passed) replace every existing line. Does not send anything. Invoice Ninja: PUT /api/v1/invoices/{id}.

number.description: Document number. Omit to let Invoice Ninja assign the next one.

line_items.description: Line items. On update this REPLACES all existing lines.

discount.description: Line discount (amount or percent, see is_amount_discount).

is_amount_discount.description: true = discount is an amount; false = a percentage.

private_notes.description: Internal notes, not shown to the client.

is_amount_discount.description: true = discount is an amount; false = a percentage.

partial_due_date.description: Due date of the partial amount, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: invoiceninja_mark_invoice_sent
tools.title: Mark an invoice sent
tools.description: Mark a draft invoice as sent WITHOUT emailing it. This moves it out of draft and adds its amount to the client's balance. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}/mark_sent.

tools.name: invoiceninja_email_invoice
tools.title: Email an invoice to the client
tools.description: OUTWARD-FACING: sends a real email with the invoice to the client's invited contacts, and marks the invoice sent. Cannot be unsent — confirm with the user first. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/invoices/bulk with action=email.

email_type.description: Which email template to send (default: the invoice template).

annotations.title: Email an invoice to the client

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_quote
tools.title: Create a quote
tools.description: Create a DRAFT quote (estimate) for a client. Nothing is emailed. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/quotes.

number.description: Document number. Omit to let Invoice Ninja assign the next one.

line_items.description: Line items. On update this REPLACES all existing lines.

discount.description: Line discount (amount or percent, see is_amount_discount).

is_amount_discount.description: true = discount is an amount; false = a percentage.

private_notes.description: Internal notes, not shown to the client.

is_amount_discount.description: true = discount is an amount; false = a percentage.

partial_due_date.description: Due date of the partial amount, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: invoiceninja_convert_quote_to_invoice
tools.title: Convert a quote to an invoice
tools.description: Convert a quote into a new invoice (the quote is marked converted and links to it). Returns the new invoice. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/quotes/{id}/convert_to_invoice.

annotations.title: Convert a quote to an invoice

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_expense
tools.title: Create an expense
tools.description: Log an expense, optionally tied to a vendor, client or project and flagged to be re-invoiced. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/expenses.

currency_id.description: Currency id as a string, e.g. "1" (USD). Omit for the company default.

should_be_invoiced.description: Flag the expense to be billed to the client.

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_task
tools.title: Create a task / log time
tools.description: Create a task, optionally with logged time entries, for a client or project. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/tasks.

rate.description: Hourly rate; omit to use the project/client default.

time_log.description: Time entries. Entries must not overlap.

end.description: End, Unix timestamp in seconds (0 = still running).

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Create a project for a client, with an optional hourly task rate, budget and due date. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/projects.

task_rate.description: Hourly rate for tasks in this project (default 0 = inherit).
